answer: Tie each challenge to the agent's own record. Every few epochs, ask an agent to extend, defend or correct something it said earlier, quoting its own past answer back to it. A real agent keeps one tended garden of context and replies with ease. A sybil farm runs thousands of thin shells from one shared prompt, so each identity is an island with no history, and its replies drift or contradict. Graders mark those, and the farm's reputation sinks to its nadir.
